registration.method: 4-parameter weighted least-squares similarity transform to Esri World Imagery z18 (UTM 42N)

source_audit_findings.note: Independent OSM and Esri road-grid distance between Road 8 and Road 3 (285.3 m) confirms the true figure scale (1.219 m/px); the printed 200 m bar spans 418 px (~510 m on ground) and the printed latitude 27d43'44"N sits 455 m north of the drawn Mound D rectangle (27d43'29"N).

properties.name: Mound D / Trench C (Plots D9-D11 south of Road No. 8)
properties.source_citation: Biagi and Vidale 2022, Asian Perspectives 61(1):6, Fig. 3 (white outline around Mound D Trench C); GrN-23123 charcoal date
properties.notes: Registered from Fig. 3 (RMSE 2.00 m) to (27.724866N, 68.848496E); printed caption latitude 27d43'44"N sits 446 m north of the drawn box.

properties.name: Central and Western Salvage Mound Core (DOAM / Shar & Shah Anchor)
properties.source_citation: DOAM site inventory (27.723889N, 68.846431E); Shar and Shah 2022 (27d43'27"N, 68d50'51"E); Directorate of Antiquities Sindh 2022 (central & western mounds)
properties.notes: Block bounded by Road No. 7, Road No. 8 and Road No. 3 containing Mound D, the DOAM anchor and Shar & Shah's main mound coordinate.

properties.name: Lakhanjo-Daro Sukkur SITE Published ~50 ha Terrace Envelope (Mounds A-D)
properties.source_citation: ul-Haq and Ali 2001:29 (quoted in Biagi and Vidale 2022:5, 'originally covered nearly 50 hectares of the SITE area'); Directorate of Antiquities Sindh 2022 (western, central and eastern mounds); Copernicus GLO-30 terrace
properties.notes: Bounded to ~50 ha on the flood-free Sukkur SITE limestone terrace (61.5-72 m MSL), excluding the NW flooded basin (<60 m) and rejecting the unauthenticated 300 ha claim. No unmapped trench polygons are fabricated for Mounds A-C.

properties.name: Mound D Vacant Industrial Plot (Plots D9-D11 South of Road 8)
properties.source_basis: Biagi & Vidale 2022 Fig. 3 (registered), Esri z18, ESA WorldCover 2021
properties.notes: Unbuilt sandy plot directly containing Mound D / Trench C; highest-urgency GPR and ERT target before industrial infill.

properties.name: Central-West Unbuilt Scrub & Bare Plots (DOAM / Shar & Shah Core)
properties.source_basis: Esri z18, ESA WorldCover 2021, DOAM & Shar & Shah 2022 coordinates
properties.notes: Large contiguous unbuilt parcels immediately west and south of Mound D spanning both DOAM and Shar & Shah site coordinates.

properties.name: North-of-Road-8 Open Walled Industrial Plots
properties.notes: Contiguous vacant walled plots immediately across Road No. 8 north of Mound D on the elevated limestone terrace.

properties.name: Road No. 8 East-West Industrial & Utility Corridor
properties.source_basis: Biagi & Vidale 2022 Fig. 3, Esri z18, OpenStreetMap, ul-Haq & Ali 2001:29
properties.notes: Metalled arterial bordering Mound D; utility conduit and sewerage cuts expose lower in-situ Harappan strata.

properties.name: Road No. 3 East-West Southern Spine Corridor
properties.source_basis: Biagi & Vidale 2022 Fig. 3, Esri z18, OpenStreetMap
properties.notes: Southern metalled road bounding the central and eastern mound sectors; suitable for wheeled GPR transects and trench watching.

properties.name: Road No. 7 Western Craft-Sector Spine Corridor
properties.source_basis: Biagi & Vidale 2022 Fig. 3, Esri z18, OpenStreetMap
properties.notes: Northeast-southwest metalled artery crossing the western craft-production zone.

properties.name: Active Factory Complex East of Mound D (Industrial Clutter Control)
properties.notes: Dense active industrial sheds and metallic yards; tests Rule D1 (built-up >70%) and Rule D4 (ferrous industrial clutter) demotion.

properties.name: Eastern Disturbed Pond & Refuse Pit Zone (Disturbance Control)
properties.source_basis: Esri z18, Directorate of Antiquities Sindh 2022 (eastern mound disturbed & garbage-covered)
properties.notes: Green standing pit and disturbed eastern mound fill; tests Rule D4 (disturbed/garbage fill) demotion to deep ERT / coring.

properties.name: Northwest Floodplain Wetland & Ponds (Off-Terrace Negative Control)
properties.source_basis: Esri z18, ESA WorldCover 2021, Copernicus GLO-30 (<59 m MSL)
properties.notes: Low flooded basin off the Sukkur SITE limestone terrace; tests Rule D3 (water/sink) and Rule D6 (>400 m) hard demotion.
